clip_key: # Mission Control jokes to the crew. New keys: mj_
# Columns and values: audio/lonapse/README.md. UTF-8, tab separated, # starts a comment line.

spanish: Control, ¿qué tiempo hace en el centro espacial?
english: Control, how's the weather at the space center? | Control, what's the weather like at the space center? | Control, how's the weather down there?
Cloudy. We envy you a little. | Gray. We're a bit jealous of you. | Cloudy. We kind of envy you.
Remember to eat something. | Don't forget to eat. | Remember lunch, {vessel}.
We're already on the sandwiches. | Already eating sandwiches. | We're on the sandwiches.

spanish: Sin migas en los paneles, por favor.
english: No crumbs on the panels, please. | No crumbs on the panels. | Keep the crumbs off the panels, please.
The scientists want more data. | The scientists want more data. | Science wants more data, {vessel}.
They always want more data. | They always do. | They always want more.
I know. I know. | I know. Believe me. | Yes. I know.
Has anyone seen my pencil? | Control, anyone seen my pencil? | Control, I lost my pencil.
Look behind panel two. | Behind panel two. | Check behind panel two.

spanish: El director pregunta si podéis saludar.
english: The director asks if you can wave. | The director wants you to wave. | The flight director asks for a wave.
Tell him we're waving. | We're waving. Tell him. | Tell him we're waving.

spanish: El becario ha tirado café en la consola.
english: The intern spilled coffee on the console. | The intern spilled coffee on the console. | Coffee on the console. The intern again.
Does that explain the weird data? | Is that why the data is weird? | That explains the strange data?
It explains a lot of things. | It explains a lot. | That explains many things.

spanish: El becario ha pulsado algo. Tranquilos.
english: The intern pressed something. Relax. | The intern pressed something. Stay calm. | Relax. The intern just pressed something.
Now we're not relaxed. | We are not calm now. | Now we're not relaxed.
It was the coffee maker. All good. | It was the coffee maker. All fine. | Only the coffee machine. Fine.

spanish: Por favor, deja de pulsar el botón brillante.
english: Please stop pressing the shiny button. | Stop pressing the shiny button, please. | Please quit pressing the shiny button.
Which one? They all shine in here. | Which one? Everything shines in here. | They're all shiny up here.

spanish: El que estás pulsando ahora mismo.
english: The one you're pressing right now. | The one you're pressing now. | That one. The one under your finger.
Your mom called. | Your mom called. | Message from your mom.
What did she say? | What did she want? | What did she say?
Put on a jacket. | Wear a jacket. | She says: put on a jacket.

spanish: Tu madre pregunta si comes bien.
english: Your mom asks if you're eating well. | Your mom wants to know if you're eating well. | Mom asks: are you eating enough?
Tell her yes. A lot. | Yes. Lots. | Tell her yes. Plenty.

spanish: Lo sabe. Ha visto el inventario.
english: She knows. She saw the inventory. | She knows. She read the inventory. | She saw the food report.

spanish: Hoy es el cumpleaños del director de vuelo.
english: Today is the flight director's birthday. | It's the flight director's birthday today. | Today the flight director turns another year older.
Happy birthday, boss! | Happy birthday, boss! | Happy birthday from up here!

spanish: Dice gracias, y que sigáis trabajando.
english: He says thanks, and get back to work. | He says thanks. Now back to work. | Thanks, he says. And get back to work.

spanish: Hay tarta en la sala de control.
english: There's cake in the control room. | There's cake in the control room. | We have cake down here.
Will you save us a piece? | Save us a slice? | Keep a piece for us?

spanish: Ya no queda nada. Lo siento.
english: It's all gone. Sorry. | Gone. Sorry. | All eaten. Sorry.

spanish: Contabilidad pregunta si podéis volver más barato.
english: Accounting asks if you can come back cheaper. | Accounting wants you to come back cheaper. | Accounting asks for a cheaper return.
Cheaper how? | Cheaper how? | How, cheaper?
Without boosters, for example. | Without boosters, maybe. | No boosters, for example.

spanish: El presupuesto de galletas está agotado.
english: The cookie budget is used up. | The cookie budget is gone. | You've used up the cookie budget.
That's an emergency! | Emergency! | This is an emergency!
Not for accounting. | Accounting disagrees. | Not for accounting.

spanish: Recordad firmar el casco antes de volver.
english: Remember to sign the hull before you come back. | Sign the hull before you come home. | Don't forget to sign the hull, {vessel}.

spanish: Ya lo hemos firmado. Por dentro.
english: Already signed it. On the inside. | Signed it already. From inside. | Done. On the inside.
It's raining nonstop down here. | It hasn't stopped raining down here. | Rain, rain and more rain here.
It never rains up here. | It never rains up here. | No rain up here.
Show-offs. | Show-offs. | Bragging.

spanish: Hace tanto viento que el becario ha volado.
english: It's so windy the intern blew away. | So windy the intern flew away. | The wind took the intern.
Did he reach orbit? | Did he make orbit? | Did he reach orbit?
Almost. He needs a booster. | Close. He needs a booster. | Nearly. Needs a booster.

spanish: Os leo una carta de un fan.
english: I'll read you a fan letter. | Fan letter for you. | I'll read you some fan mail.
Go ahead! | Go on! | Read it!
It says: can you bring me a rock? | It says: please bring me a rock. | They write: can I have a rock?

spanish: Carta de un fan: pide más propulsores.
english: Fan letter: they want more boosters. | Fan mail: more boosters, please. | A fan writes: they want more boosters.
Finally someone with taste! | Someone with taste! | Finally, good taste!
A fan wants your autograph. | A fan asks for your autograph. | Someone wants your signature.
I'll sign a cookie. | I'll sign a cookie. | I'll autograph a cookie.
It will arrive as crumbs. | It'll arrive as crumbs. | That arrives as crumbs.
Inventory: you have twenty cookies left. | Inventory says twenty cookies left. | Cookie count: twenty.
Nineteen. | Nineteen. | Make that nineteen.
Eighteen, by the sound of it. | Eighteen, from the sound of it. | Eighteen, I hear.

spanish: ¿Quién se ha comido las raciones de mañana?
english: Who ate tomorrow's rations? | Who ate tomorrow's food? | Tomorrow's rations are gone. Who?
Tomorrow's tasted better. | Tomorrow's was tastier. | It tasted better than today's.

spanish: Recordad: los pepinillos son para emergencias.
english: Remember: the pickles are for emergencies. | The pickles are for emergencies. Remember. | Reminder: pickles are emergency food.

spanish: Ha sido una emergencia de hambre.
english: It was a hunger emergency. | It was a hunger emergency. | We had a hunger emergency.

spanish: Ingeniería dice que no hacen falta más puntales.
english: Engineering says no more struts are needed. | Engineering says you don't need more struts. | No more struts, says engineering.
Engineering isn't sitting in here. | Engineering isn't sitting up here. | Engineering isn't up here with us.
Stop licking the window. | Please stop licking the window. | Quit licking the window.
How do you know? | How do you know that? | How can you tell?
The interior camera. | Interior camera. | We have a camera in there.

spanish: Te dejaste el coche mal aparcado.
english: You left your car badly parked. | Your car is badly parked. | You parked your car very badly.
Did I get a ticket? | A ticket? | Did I get a ticket?

spanish: Dos. Te esperan a la vuelta.
english: Two. They're waiting for you. | Two. Waiting for you. | Two of them. They'll wait.
News: our team won. | Big news: our team won. | Our team won the match.
I knew they could! | I knew it! | I knew they could do it!
The other team didn't show up. | The other team never showed up. | The other team didn't come.
Pop quiz: what is an orbit? | Quick quiz: what's an orbit? | Pop quiz, {vessel}: what is an orbit?
Falling and missing the ground? | Falling and missing the ground? | Falling, but missing?
Correct. Ten points. | Correct. Ten points. | Right. Ten points.

spanish: ¿Por qué fue el cohete al colegio?
english: Why did the rocket go to school? | Why did the rocket go to school? | Joke time. Why did the rocket go to school?
Don't know. Why? | Why? | No idea. Why?
To level up. | To level up. | It wanted to level up.

spanish: ¿Cómo se prepara una fiesta en el espacio?
english: How do you throw a party in space? | How do you plan a party in space? | Space party. How do you organize one?
How? | How? | Tell us.
You planet. | You planet. | You planet it.

spanish: Por favor, espere. Su llamada es importante.
english: Please hold. Your call is important to us. | Please hold. Your call matters to us. | You are on hold. Please stay on the line.
Control? Hello? | Control? Hello? | Hello? Control?
Just kidding. We're here. | Kidding. We're here. | Just joking. We're here.
Lost and found has your sock. | Lost and found has your sock. | Your sock turned up at lost and found.
How did it get there? | How did it get down there? | How?

spanish: Es un misterio de la ingeniería.
english: It's an engineering mystery. | Engineering mystery. | Nobody knows. Engineering is baffled.
Remember to tidy up before you come back. | Tidy up before you come back. | Clean up before coming home.
The crumbs too? | Crumbs too? | Even the crumbs?
Especially the crumbs. | Crumbs most of all. | Especially those.

spanish: Bonito aterrizaje. Casi todo de una pieza.
english: Nice landing. Mostly in one piece. | Nice landing. Mostly one piece. | Good landing. Most of you is still there.
Mostly counts. | Mostly is enough. | Mostly counts.

spanish: Los científicos piden una roca bonita.
english: The scientists want a pretty rock. | Science wants a pretty rock. | The scientists asked for a nice rock.
Pretty according to whom? | Pretty for who? | Who decides pretty?
Any rock. They're not picky. | Any rock. They don't care. | Any rock will do.

spanish: Felicidades, la nave sigue de pie.
english: Congratulations, the ship is still standing. | Congrats, the ship is still upright. | Well done. The ship is standing.
Surprised? | Surprised? | You sound surprised.
A little, yes. | A bit, yes. | Honestly? Yes.

spanish: Antes de despegar: ¿has ido al baño?
english: Before liftoff: did you go to the bathroom? | Before liftoff: bathroom done? | Quick check: did everyone use the bathroom?
Yes, mom. | Yes, mom. | Yes, mother.
Very funny. | Hilarious. | Very funny.

spanish: Enhorabuena, oficialmente estáis cayendo con estilo.
english: Congrats, you're officially falling with style. | Congratulations. You are falling with style. | Officially, you're falling with style.
We always had style. | We always had style. | Style was never the problem.

spanish: Os quedan muchos días de viaje.
english: You have many days of travel left. | Many days of travel left. | You still have a long way to go.
How many cookies per day? | How many cookies a day? | And cookies per day?
Half of one. | Half a cookie. | One half.

spanish: Marketing quiere pintar el cohete de rosa.
english: Marketing wants to paint the rocket pink. | Marketing wants a pink rocket. | Marketing asks to paint the rocket pink.
With pink boosters? | Pink boosters too? | Even the boosters?
Especially the boosters. | The boosters most of all. | Boosters first.

spanish: Habéis ganado el premio al vuelo del mes.
english: You won flight of the month. | You're flight of the month. | Flight of the month goes to you.
Were there other flights? | Were there other flights? | Any other flights?

spanish: No. Pero el trofeo es bonito.
english: No. But the trophy is nice. | No. The trophy is nice, though. | None. Nice trophy, though.

spanish: Hemos escrito mal tu nombre en la placa.
english: We misspelled your name on the plaque. | We spelled your name wrong on the plaque. | The plaque has a typo. Your name.
How badly? | How wrong? | How bad?
It says Cookie. | It says Cookie. | It reads Cookie.
Last night you snored over the radio. | You snored on the radio last night. | We heard you snoring on the radio.
I don't snore. | I do not snore. | That wasn't me.
We have it on tape. | It's recorded. | We have the recording.

spanish: ¿Quién ha dibujado en el manual de vuelo?
english: Who drew in the flight manual? | Who drew in the flight manual? | Someone colored in the flight manual.
We improved it. | We made it better. | Improvements.
Now it has more boosters. | It has more boosters now. | Now it has extra boosters.
